config.format_instruction: Extract the clinical facts stated in the note into one JSON object. Return JSON only, without markdown or commentary. Use these exact top-level fields: visit motivation, admission, patient information, patient medical history, surgeries, symptoms, medical examinations, diagnosis tests, treatments, discharge. For absent information, omit inner subfields, use [] for empty list sections (admission, surgeries, symptoms, medical examinations, diagnosis tests, treatments), use {} for empty object sections (patient information, patient medical history, discharge), and use "None" only for an absent visit motivation. Do not invent facts or repeat identical entries.
